translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel chronic heat within the intestines and stomach, the eight jaundices (八疸), yellowing of body and face, dry lips with dry mouth, shortness of breath, free the monthly water (通月水), and stop excess urination. One [name] ... one name is 天瓜, one name is 澤姑. The fruit, named 黃瓜, treats chest impediment (胸痹) and makes [the skin] glossy
